item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 17/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to bring generally fine weather to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. It will still be cool in the morning over the region and cold over parts of inland areas, where the temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. With the northeast monsoon moderating slightly early next week, temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise progressively. A fresh to strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. It will be cloudier and windier over the region.
